dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.23

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG BEETS_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache --virtual=build-dependencies \
    build-base \
    cairo-dev \
    cargo \
    cmake \
    ffmpeg-dev \
    fftw-dev \
    git \
    gobject-introspection-dev \
    jpeg-dev \
    libedit-dev \
    libpng-dev \
    mpg123-dev \
    openjpeg-dev \
    python3-dev && \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    chromaprint \
    expat \
    ffmpeg \
    fftw \
    flac \
    gdbm \
    gobject-introspection \
    gst-plugins-good \
    gstreamer \
    imagemagick \
    jpeg \
    lame \
    libffi \
    libpng \
    mpg123 \
    mp3gain \
    nano \
    openjpeg \
    python3 \
    sqlite-libs && \
  echo "**** install beets ****" && \
  if [ -z ${BEETS_VERSION+x} ] ; then \
    BEETS_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/beetbox/beets/commits/master" \
    | jq -r .sha); \
  fi && \
  git clone https://github.com/beetbox/beets.git /tmp/beets && \
  cd /tmp/beets && \
  git checkout -f "${BEETS_VERSION}" && \
  echo "**** compile mp3val ****" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /tmp/mp3val-src && \
  curl -o \
  /tmp/mp3val-src/mp3val.tar.gz -sL \
    https://downloads.sourceforge.net/mp3val/mp3val-0.1.8-src.tar.gz && \
  cd /tmp/mp3val-src && \
  tar xzf /tmp/mp3val-src/mp3val.tar.gz --strip 1 && \
  make -f Makefile.linux && \
  cp -p mp3val /usr/bin && \
  echo "**** install pip packages ****" && \
  python3 -m venv /lsiopy && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir \
    pip \
    setuptools && \
  echo "**** install beets ****" && \
  cd /tmp/beets && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.23/ . && \
  echo "**** install pip packages ****" && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.23/ \
    beautifulsoup4 \
    beets-extrafiles \
    beetcamp \
    python3-discogs-client \
    flask \
    flask-cors \
    PyGObject \
    pyacoustid \
    pylast \
    requests \
    requests_oauthlib \
    typing-extensions \
    unidecode && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    $HOME/.cache \
    $HOME/.cargo

# environment settings
ENV BEETSDIR="/config" \
EDITOR="nano" \
HOME="/config"

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8337
VOLUME /config

units.name: init-beets-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# copy config
cp -n /defaults/beets.sh /config/beets.sh
cp -n /defaults/config.yaml /config/config.yaml

chmod +x /config/beets.sh

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    # permissions
    lsiown -R abc:abc \
        /config
fi

units.name: svc-beets
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8337" \
            s6-setuidgid abc beet web
else
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8337" \
            beet web
fi

notes.upstream:
Lint: enable `eradicate` and `flake8-simplify` (#7147)

## Enable `ERA` and `SIM` ruff rules across the codebase 🧹

This turns on two more ruff rule families, `ERA` (eradicate,
commented-out code) and `SIM` (flake8-simplify), and fixes everything
they flag in `beets/`, `beetsplug/` and `test/`. Apart from the two
small exceptions under Notes, behaviour doesn't change. The goal is to
make the linter catch dead code and nested-`if` / `try: ... except:
pass` boilerplate so reviewers don't have to.

## Key Changes

### 1. Remove commented-out code (`ERA`) 🪦

- **Change:** Deleted stale commented-out code: unused `penalty_string`
call in `beets/ui/commands/import_/display.py`, `play_simple`, `bpm`,
unused `mp3gain` fields and `exc_watcher.join()` in `replaygain`,
debugging `print`s and `time.sleep` in tests, dead assertions in
`test_ui.py` and `test_types_plugin.py`.
- **Change:** Moved the "safe mocks" example in
`test/plugins/test_art.py` into the docstring as a doctest-style
example.
- **Change:** Where a comment only looks like code (`# Reimport`, the
`date_time is (...)` explanation in `beets/importer/tasks.py`, the
`mimetype` TODO in `beetsplug/aura.py`), it's kept and marked with `#
noqa: ERA001`.

### 2. Fix Yoda conditions (`SIM300`) 🧙

- **Change:** `"expected" == actual` is now `actual == "expected"`. This
is mostly in tests (`test_bpd.py`, `test_types.py`, `test_spotify.py`
and others), plus a few spots in `beets/dbcore/query.py` and
`beetsplug/_utils/requests.py`.

### 3. Apply flake8-simplify (`SIM`) ✂️

- **Change:** These patterns were rewritten mechanically:

| Pattern | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Nested `if` (`SIM102`) | `if a:` / `if b:` | `if a and b:` |
| `if`/`else` assignment (`SIM108`) | four-line `if`/`else` | ternary |
| `try`/`except: pass` (`SIM105`) | `try: ... except X: pass` | `with
contextlib.suppress(X):` |
| Loop returning bool (`SIM110`) | `for ...: if ...: return True` /
`return False` | `any(...)` |
| Return bool (`SIM103`) | `if cond: return False` / `return True` |
`return not cond` |
| Nested `with` (`SIM117`) | nested `with` / `async with` |
parenthesised multi-item `with` |
| `.keys()` membership/iteration (`SIM118`) | `for k in d.keys()` | `for
k in d` |
| `str.split()` literals (`SIM905`) | `"ipfs add -q -r".split()` |
`["ipfs", "add", "-q", "-r"]` |

- **Change:** `SIM108` is suppressed in `beets/dbcore/query.py` and
`beets/util/layout.py`, and `SIM115` in `beetsplug/export.py`, where the
rewrite would read worse or the file deliberately stays open past the
expression.

### Tests 🧪

- Test code is only touched for lint fixes (Yoda conditions, nested
`with`, `contextlib.suppress`, removed dead code).
- One previously commented-out assertion in
`test/plugins/test_types_plugin.py::test_date_modify_and_query`
(`mydate:1999-12-30`) is now active again. It used to be disabled with
`FIXME some sort of timezone issue here`.

## Notes 📝

- **Behaviour change in `playlist` query:** `beetsplug/playlist.py` now
reads the playlist inside `with open(...)`. The file is always closed,
and an `OSError` raised while reading (not just while opening) now skips
to the next playlist instead of propagating.
- **Behaviour change in `util.move`:** the temporary file copy in
`beets/util/__init__.py` now uses a single `with` block for both files,
with `delete=False` kept. The resulting file is the same.
- **Re-enabled timezone assertion:** see Tests. If it's flaky in CI, it
should be reverted to the commented-out state rather than worked around.
